# B08 — Measured model routing and interruptible voice

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B07. Outcome: the right model is chosen by evidence, words are grounded in verified state, and speech can be interrupted promptly.

Read `server/llm/types.ts`, `server/llm/gemini.ts`, `server/llm/faculties.ts`, `server/voice/live/`, `src/lib/audio/`, `server/cognition/`. Load only functions for the active slice. Existing tests: `tests/llm/`, `tests/voice/`. New tests belong beside the behavior.

Planned files: `server/llm/provider.ts`, `server/llm/router.ts`, `server/voice/live/session.ts` (response-ID-aware), `src/lib/voice.ts`.

## Slices

- **s1:** Faculty seam. Define `server/llm/provider.ts` (`Faculty` + `FacultyProvider` interfaces, `FacultyRole`). Implement a Gemini adapter behind the interface and a local stub (e.g. Ollama/Qwen) behind the same interface. Add `server/llm/router.ts` that selects the faculty by role/budget/mode (`local | hybrid | quality`), enforces `LLM_TIMEOUT_MS`, and falls back deterministically without silent paid calls. Swapping the provider must not change `server/app.ts` architecture. Test provider swap, timeout fallback, and zero-paid refusal.
- **s2:** Grounded responses. Implement `ResponseFrame` (`turnId`, facts with provenance, `acceptedJobIds`, `verifiedOutcomeIds`, `activeWork`, uncertainties, style preferences, optional `viewIntent`). Business completion statements must cite verified outcomes; otherwise state the actual accepted/running state. Validate each utterance segment before TTS; do not speak raw planner output. Test Hinglish paraphrases, missing verification → no completion claim, and J12 unseen wording.
- **s3:** Interruptible speech. Bind audio chunks to `{responseId, seq}`. On barge-in invalidate `responseId`, flush the playback queue, and ensure late packets for the old response never resume. `stopSpeaking` stops audio for one `responseId`; it does not cancel the job unless the owner also asked to stop the work. Measure p95 barge-in silence (target <200 ms). Test interruption mid-utterance, queue flush, and job-continuation after `stopSpeaking`.

Add numbered migrations only after inspecting the latest migration list; never rewrite applied SQL. Each slice must first exhibit the defect. Do not bundle all three into one small-model prompt.

## Gate

A provider can be swapped without application-code changes. No business completion is claimed without a verified outcome. J11 passes: interruption stops obsolete audio and does not cancel the underlying job. Barge-in latency is measured and reported; misses are reported, not hidden. No silent paid fallback in the failure matrix.

Next: B09/s1. No new tool capability here.
